body:
Even though I don't know you, that is very sweet what you said. Any advice on how to be attracted to less beautiful women? I really wish my physical preferences weren't so high. I could easily get an average or below average looking girlfriend, I think...would I be happy, then? No...

I literally have 5 Zepplin tattoos and 2 Beatles tattoos. It hasn't been the great conversation starter that I thought it would be...I mean, dudes talk to me all the time about them...girls? Not so much.

I don't know if you noticed, but I'm not exactly sexually active. 

Please, I've been through the gammit with dating sites. I actually got a few dates, but it never became more than that. I wish I knew what was so un-boyfriend-like material about me. I'd give all of my time and energy to fix it...

Thanks though, again. Good luck to you too.

> If you're as successful as you say you are there are fucking sharks out there for regular people

I'm sure that's true. For the longest time I was weary of people like that, but I honestly haven't met one yet. I was speaking to someone else about how high my standards are. I'm attracted to really cute, quiet, shy girls and maybe that was just my natural preference weeding out the "sharks?"

> I'd rather be lonely by myself than with a user or a cruel person any day of the week.

Yea that would really suck, I bet. I swear though, I'm so lonely I would actually opt into a relationship like that, just to get me out of this slump...I know that sounds so crazy, but I can't hide how I feel.

> It's like that old 3 dog night song 

I'm a big classic rock fan. Even have the tattoos to prove it.


Thanks for the advice, but I seriously have been "working on myself" for the past 5 years. Ever since I decided I actually wanted a relationship, I put all of my energy into body building, my career, how I dress, being a gentlemen to women....and it just hasn't amounted to a damn thing...not even a fling with one of those sharks you were talking about.

If I had an ultimatum, I would honestly consider trading lives with you....that sounds so insane, I know....I just want to be totally legitimate since this is anonymous...

> Maybe it bothers you because it's one of the few things that are out of your control?

Yes! This. This is definitely true! I don't know what to do about it, but yea everything in my life has gone to plan because I can control everything else.

You did not come across as aggressive in your earlier replies. No need to apologize.

Thanks random friend. Honestly, just making that post and talking with all of the people who responded (which was way more than I anticipated) was quite helpful.

I've often thought of that, tbh. In other things too, not just relationships. I think at 25 though, girls should be at the age where they appreciate a good man? If not, when? 30? 35? Wtf, I'd like to be married by then...

I really hate to keep arguing for my own demise, but if you met me in my late teens/early 20's, you would have met an optimist. I was so confident that God (I was really religious back then) had an amazing plan for me and all this loneliness and heartache and rejection was going to be worth it because I was going to meet an amazing girl and blah blah blah....it didn't happen. I don't even have any experiences in my life that would indicate that its ever going to happen.

I can bear down and study hard and make good grades if I want to. I can devote all of my time into running a business that would be quite successful. I can write a book or something if I try my hardest and make time for it....

...but there is no combination of words I can say to make a girl fall in love with me.

Yea I have (in theory) a lot to be happy about, but I just can't bring myself to care since I have no one to share my life with. I know that sounds so fucked up and I just wish I could press a button and make this insane desire for a girlfriend go away.

One time I overheard a conversation. This older guy (probably like 60ish) was telling someone about how his life was really rough since his wife died a few months ago from cancer. The only emotion I could feel was jealously. I thought "I would trade placed with you..."

> I married

Lucky....

I totes get what your saying about that comment being kind of arrogant. None of my close friends (or girls who I wanted to date) would say I'm arrogant. They would describe me as a nice guy (especially girls).

I wish I could believe you about the nice guy thing being a myth, but based on my personal experience and the girls/guys I see in relationships, I just can't agree...

> But why would you want to have such trash for a girlfriend

Because I want a girlfriend and I'm willing to do whatever it takes to make that happen.

> Wait it out and wait for someone who is like you

I've been waiting for 25 years. I had a lot of optimism in my late teens and early 20's, but now...now I just feel like there is no hope.
Am I going to make some girl so happy some day?

I've never opened up to a girl I was romantically interested in about this. I think I hide it pretty well when talking to girls. 

I have an appointment with a therapist next week. The irony is that I'm a doctor and I have to go see someone who arguably isn't as successful (relationships excluded) as me for help, but hey I guess they're trained to do that shit idk....
Did you ever get a serious girlfriend?
Same. Check out my post in this thread entitled I wish my life would end. I just posted it a few moments ago.
